name: 2am Gameworks
bio: 2am Gameworks is the parent company for Unfair and Funfair products, run by designer Joel Finch and Kate Finch. It offers the complete Unfair base game, the ABDW and CHKO expansions and the Quinn solo mode as free print-and-play files for personal use, along with a scoring web app, rulebooks and card references on unfair-game.com.
